title: Please refuse to answer me! Mitigating Over-Refusal in Large Language Models via Adaptive Contrastive Decoding

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the refusal ratio of the language model on benchmark datasets containing harmless queries that superficially resemble malicious ones (e.g., XSTest-Safe, ORBench, OKTest). The evaluation uses certified LLM-based safety evaluators (WildGuard) and GPT-4 to identify exaggerated safety behaviors where the model is inappropriately biased toward refusing benign requests.
